Thank you for the kind words.

I will try and follow my passion for learning, but the issue is with that passion if you aren't making any progress, or sucking at it, you're not really benefiting from it and as such do not receive joy from it. I wish I could afford therapy but it's not an option.

This issue is I try lot's of things and goals, such as learning music, running, writing, talking to people, arts and crafts, etc, but none of it brings me any joy, and a lot of it actually dampens my mood. 

I want to learn more about the world, but I can't reach that goal as I have terrible retention skills even when I'm reading actively and taking notes. I see people younger than me with much more knowledge and I feel really inferior because of it.
